decisions.reason: The vegan superfood drink sits far from the firm's engineering and conversion knowledge, so it cannot interpret consumer-market feedback well, and its absence from the website in 2020 and 2021 suggests it has already lost priority.

The modular waste-to-energy extensions build directly on the firm's plant engineering and prototyping skills, so it can keep absorbing results and improving them, although their absence from the website adds some uncertainty.

As a flagship resting on core energy-from-waste knowledge, backed by its own R&D and university cooperation, the waste-oil plant is the product the firm is best placed to learn from and develop further.

The plastic-to-fuel plant is a strategic flagship close to the firm's conversion expertise, and its research partnerships give it the knowledge to refine the technology, though technical risk and its absence from the website raise the chance of withdrawal.
